title: Quietly Spicy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A citrusy and gooey Algerian dish featuring chilli powder, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made in a stone bowl dolsot and paleo friendly.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into 2 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, and chilli powder.
Heat the olive oil in the stone bowl dolsot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the dolsot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the dolsot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the seasoned lamb pieces to the dolsot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the lemon juice and prunes to the dolsot and stir to combine.
Cover the dolsot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce is gooey.
